description: Needs the user's AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; each call uses one AI analysis from the licence quota. Evaluates a practised negotiation from the buyer's side: a grade (very good, good, solid or needs work), what was reached, what the buyer did well, what to improve and one sentence for the real meeting. Pass the situation and the full transcript of the practice. Negotiation guidance, not legal advice. The transcript is processed for this answer only and is not stored by KULIC Advisory.

goal.description: Optional: what the buyer wanted to reach.

language.description: Language of the answer: de, en, fr, es, pt or zh. Default de.

name: evaluate_negotiation
title: Evaluate the practised negotiation: grade, what went well, what to improve and one sentence for the real meeting (AICTIONBOT™ negotiation sparring)
